method: Polynomial (quadratic plus cubes) in eight levers scaled to [-1, 1], least squares on fast-loop runs (run_model.run, every sector on the stub, supply on the stand-in), shifted so it returns the reference run exactly at EIA's settings. Error: refit without every fifth hypercube run, then predicted those; percent of the output's typical size over all years.

instant.name: carbon_price
instant.title: Carbon price
instant.label: Carbon price (stand-in)
instant.unit: 2024 $ per metric ton CO2, from start_year
instant.moves: Delivered fossil prices by carbon content, power plants' fuel costs
instant.why: Prices and power plants' fuel switching come from fitted curves

instant.name: ev_share
instant.title: EV sales
instant.label: EV sales (stand-in)
instant.unit: plug-in share of new light-duty sales, 0-1 (EIA's reference: 0.49 in 2030, 0.65 in 2035)
instant.moves: With TRAN: the plug-ins' utility in TALT2X, the powertrain choice. Stub: gasoline to electricity as the fleet turns over
instant.why: Transportation is not ported in this run: a fleet-turnover estimate moves its fuel use

instant.name: building_code
instant.title: Building codes
instant.label: Building codes (stand-in)
instant.unit: fraction less heating and cooling need in new buildings
instant.moves: Commercial KSHEFF shell factors; residential RSMSHL HTSHEFF and CLSHEFF
instant.why: Needs a ported buildings sector: this run has none, so the lever is refused

instant.name: appliance_standard
instant.title: Appliance standards
instant.label: Appliance standards (stand-in)
instant.unit: fraction more efficient than the least efficient equipment on offer
instant.moves: Commercial KTEK availability years; residential RSMEQP RTEQEFF, RTEQCOST, RTRECOST
instant.why: Needs a ported buildings sector: this run has none, so the lever is refused

instant.name: coal_retirement
instant.title: Coal retirements
instant.label: Coal retirements (stand-in)
instant.unit: share of EIA's coal fleet closed early, reached by 2035
instant.moves: LP: coal capacity. Stand-in: coal burn, made up by the fitted mix of what meets new sales
instant.why: Moves coal burn by a fitted mix; no plants close in the model

instant.name: renewable_cost
instant.title: Renewable cost
instant.label: Renewable cost (stand-in)
instant.unit: -1 EIA's low zero-carbon cost case, 0 reference, +1 EIA's high case
instant.moves: LP: wind and solar capacity as in EIA's case. Stand-in: power-sector fuel use and retail electricity prices as in EIA's case
instant.why: Scales EIA's side case for power-sector fuel use; no cost enters any model

instant.name: load_growth
instant.title: Load growth
instant.label: Load growth (stand-in)
instant.unit: TWh of extra US electricity sales in 2050, linear from start_year
instant.moves: Commercial electricity sales (QBLK/qelcm), by division as EIA splits them
instant.why: Extra sales added by hand; a fitted mix and fitted prices respond

instant.name: gas_supply
instant.title: Gas supply
instant.label: Gas supply (stand-in)
instant.unit: -1 EIA's low oil and gas supply case, 0 reference, +1 EIA's high case
instant.moves: Delivered gas and retail electricity prices by that case's (its oil price is the oil lever's)
instant.why: Scales delivered gas prices toward EIA's side case; no gas market model runs

instant.name: oil_price
instant.title: Oil price
instant.label: Oil price (stand-in)
instant.unit: multiple of EIA's Brent price, from start_year
instant.moves: INTOUT/brent_price, passed through to refined product prices dollar for dollar
instant.why: Crude passes through to product prices dollar for dollar; no world oil or refining model runs

instant.name: nuclear
instant.title: Nuclear
instant.label: Nuclear (stand-in)
instant.unit: multiple of EIA's nuclear output, reached by 2040
instant.moves: LP: nuclear capacity. Stand-in: uranium burn, the change met by the fitted mix
instant.why: Moves uranium burn by a fitted mix; no reactors in the model, no build cost
